data.title: Senior / Lead Analyst, Customer Insights
data.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs. We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there. For more information, visit .Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia Analytics sits at the center of how Arcadia turns complex healthcare data into better outcomes and smarter decisions. On the product side, that means building and owning the productized analytics engines — risk, medical economics, episodes-of-care, and more — that power Arcadia's platform company-wide, built once and delivered at scale across our entire customer base. On the Customer Insights side, that means going deep on a specific customer's specific problem: custom data models, bespoke dashboards, advisory work, and long-running embedded programs that don't fit a one-size-fits-all product. We describe Customer Insights' work as sitting between a platform and a plan — more customized and hands-on than an off-the-shelf reporting product, more flexible and embedded in the customer's actual decisions than a traditional outsourced consulting engagement. We're currently hiring for several closely related analyst roles across this broader Analytics organization — spanning ownership of one of Arcadia's core analytics engines, program-specific analytical development for a major state Medicaid risk-stratification initiative, versatile project and retainer delivery across our health system and payer customers, and dedicated analytics support for a major national health plan's Medicaid program. All of these roles sit at the Senior Analyst or Lead Analyst level, combine technical excellence with real influence over analytic strategy and (for some placements) product direction, and shape how Arcadia and its customers use data to improve population health outcomes, reduce costs, and enable smarter healthcare decisions. The skills and experience below are characteristic across these roles as a set — not every requirement applies to every specific seat, and we don't expect any one candidate to bring all of it. We'll work with you during the interview process to identify which role is the best fit for your background and interests. What Success Looks Like In 3 months - Ramp into your specific engagement's data model, technical stack, and stakeholder relationships — every Customer Insights engagement has real history and context to build into, not a blank slate - Learn Arcadia's core analytics platform and toolset (QuickSight, Foundry, dbt, the AWS ecosystem) as used in your engagement - Deliver your first piece of analytical work that demonstrates clear value to your engagement's stakeholders In 6 months - Own meaningful pieces of delivery independently — whether that's a program's analytical development, a portfolio of retainer/project work, or a dedicated account's dashboarding and reporting - Be a credible, independent presence in front of the customers or partners tied to your engagement - Contribute to at least one reusable analytical asset, framework, or automation that extends beyond your immediate engagement - Begin taking on the ongoing health of your area, not just its delivery — standing up a backlog/tech-debt process, or growing into a broader backup role alongside your engagement's primary owner, depending on placement In 12 months - Be a recognized expert in your engagement area, trusted with its most complex or ambiguous work - Actively identify and pursue opportunities for automation, scalability, and reuse across your work - Have grown into deeper ownership than where you started — full backup or co-owner on an account, sole steward of a program's tech-debt and backlog, or, for analytics-engine placements, the architect shaping that engine's roadmap toward being market-leading What You'll Be Doing Technical Analytical Delivery - Translate ambiguous or partially-scoped business and clinical questions into a concrete, buildable data plan, then build the underlying data model, code, and analysis on top of it - Develop and maintain analytical pipelines and reusable data assets using SQL, dbt, and Arcadia's core data platform (Foundry, AWS data lake environments) - For analytics-engine placements: serve as the lead analytics strategist for at least one of Arcadia's productized analytics engines (e.g., risk, medical economics, episodes-of-care), owning it end-to-end while contributing to others - For engagements involving predictive or risk models: design and build the models, partnering with a dedicated Data Science team on training and validation — a consultative relationship, not a daily modeling partnership - Build dashboards, provider scorecards, registries, and other analytical deliverables (QuickSight and beyond) on top of that modeling work, as the engagement calls for it - Maintain the analytical integrity and quality of your work, flagging issues before they reach a customer or partner; for senior placements, oversee analytic quality standards and rigor across engagements more broadly, not just your own Program and Project Management - Manage delivery — whether that's a single program's delivery calendar and decision log, or a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple customers — surfacing risks and tradeoffs before they become blocking issues - Create client-facing materials — status decks, decision memos, technical explainers — tailored to a range of stakeholders, from highly technical counterparts to policy or business stakeholders with limited technical background - Delegate routine or repeatable work to junior analysts as your engagement grows, and help cross-train others for coverage - Lead cross-functional analytic initiatives that span multiple teams or engagements Customer and Cross-Functional Partnership - Serve as a primary or supporting day-to-day contact for your engagement's customers or delivery partners, navigating scope and timeline conversations directly - Partner with Customer Management, Growth, Product, and/or Engineering — depending on placement — on account strategy, product direction, or analytics roadmap; for analytics-engine placements, partner closely with product and engineering to deliver Arcadia's analytics roadmap and contribute directly to product innovation - Hold real authority at the boundaries where your work meets someone else's — able to require rework or hold a handoff that isn't ready (e.g., with a partner Data Science team), or push back on what's actually worth building with Customer Management, Growth, or Product, rather than defaulting to whatever's asked - Act as an internal thought leader on your area of expertise, contributing to Arcadia's broader analytics strategy and reusable methodology — and, for some placements, an external one, representing Arcadia's analytic capabilities at customer meetings, industry conferences, and in publications Team Contribution - Mentor and develop junior analysts, building organizational capacity beyond your own individual delivery - Take ownership of your area's long-term health, not just its immediate delivery — a backlog/tech-debt log, a growing backup role on an account, or a roadmap for an analytics engine, depending on placement - Apply AI tooling as a standard part of your workflow — analysis, QA, documentation — not an occasional accelerant - Identify opportunities for automation, scalability, and reusability in analytical delivery, and help build those improvements out What You'll Bring - Strong SQL and data modeling expertise — able to translate ambiguous business or clinical requirements into a concrete data plan, then build the underlying code and analysis on top of it - Healthcare data experience — claims and/or clinical data, with value-based care familiarity - Direct customer- or partner-facing experience — comfortable scoping and presenting without close oversight - Comfortable adopting AI tooling as a standard part of an analytical workflow - For Lead-level placement: demonstrated experience leading analytical work independently, managing multiple stakeholders, and mentoring less experienced analysts Note: our experience bar across these roles generally skews toward Lead-level expectations, even for some Senior Analyst placements — but not every skill listed here or below applies to every specific seat. Would Love For You To Have - Experience with dbt-based analytics engine development (e.g., risk, medical economics, episodes-of-care) and partnering with product/engineering on roadmap - Dashboarding experience — QuickSight or a comparable BI tool - Enough quantitative/ML fluency to build models and hand them to a Data Science team for training - Experience with medical economics, risk algorithms, quality data, and/or episodes-of-care analytics - Prior experience with state Medicaid programs or similar large government health programs - Prior experience in a project-based/retainer delivery model spanning multiple customers, rather than a single dedicated account - Experience working within a prime contractor or partner structure on shared delivery - Experience presenting analytic capabilities externally — customer meetings, industry conferences, publications - Python for analysis and QA; familiarity with the AWS ecosystem, Jira, and Confluence Note: this list spans skills relevant to several different roles across the Analytics organization — we don't expect any given candidate to have all of them. Bring what you have; we'll talk through the rest during the interview process. What You'll Get - Become a member of the talented, energized, diverse and purpose-driven Arcadian Community with decades of collective experience in population health, product development, and data science - Employee driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart - Competitive compensation and strong benefits, including Flexible Time Off The opportunity to: - Own real, high-stakes analytical work across some of Arcadia's most complex customer relationships and highest-visibility internal analytics products - Work across a genuinely varied set of problems — deep technical program ownership, versatile multi-account delivery, or company-wide analytics engines, depending on placement - Build models and analytical assets that directly shape care and coverage decisions for the members and patients they serve Senior Analyst: $125,000 – $145,000 a year Lead Analyst: $145,000 – $170,000 a year About Arcadia Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.Protect Yourself If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

data.title: Senior Director, Business Analytics & Operations
data.description:
Job Description: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large. About the Role: Wiley Research is executing a three-year transformation — from its strong publishing foundation through a connected intelligence layer to essential research infrastructure. The Business Management & Strategic Programs (BMSP) team is the connective tissue between the EVP's strategic agenda and the day-to-day work of the Research business. The Director, Business Analytics & Operations is the operating and analytical engine that keeps this ambition on track. This role combines two critical capabilities: the disciplined operating-rhythm and executive-support functions of a business operations leader, and the data and analytics leadership needed to instrument a growth strategy in a complex and matrixed organization. The Senior Director partners directly with the VP, Business Management & Strategic Programs and the EVP and GM, Research to translate strategic direction into structured execution, and builds the analytical foundation — dashboards, KPI frameworks, pipeline intelligence, financial governance — without which no data-led growth model can scale. The ideal candidate has operated at the intersection of business operations and data analytics in a large, matrixed organization, has supported P&L-owning senior leaders, and brings the credibility to act as a trusted proxy across functions. This is an execution-oriented role with visibility and consequence. Job Responsibilities: 1. Business Operations & Executive Operating Rhythm - Design and own the operating cadence for the EVP and GM, Research and its Business Management & Strategic Programs team. This will include weekly team meetings, executive meetings, monthly business reviews, and board reporting cycles — ensuring every session is decision-ready and action-tracked. - Serve as a senior operating partner and trusted advisor to the VP; act as a credible proxy in cross-functional forums where the VP's perspective needs representation. - Drive accountability across the Business Management & Strategic Programs team: maintain a central initiative register, track commitments, surface blockers, and ensure follow-through on strategic workstreams. - Lead high-priority special projects on behalf of the VP, including those involving operating model design, crossfunctional alignment, and transformation sequencing. - Prepare and quality-control executive-facing materials — board deck inputs, Research Leadership Team briefings, and EVP talking points — owning the narrative architecture that keeps the team's communications coherent across audiences. 2. Business Analytics & Performance Intelligence - Stand up and own the Business Analytics function for the Business Management & Strategic Programs team — the data infrastructure the four strategic bets depend on to scale. - Define, instrument, and maintain the core KPI set across the four strategic bets and enabling tracks; replace retrospective QBR reporting with a forward-looking pipeline accountability mechanism. - Build integrated executive dashboards combining pipeline, revenue, commercial signals, and operational performance data; ensure senior leaders have decision-ready visibility at all times. - Apply advanced analytical tools and techniques to complex business questions — modeling revenue scenarios, identifying behavioral signals, and quantifying the impact of strategic choices with clarity and speed. - Partner with Technology & Operations and AI & Data Analytics teams to ensure data quality, governance, and infrastructure are fit for purpose; influence roadmap decisions where gaps exist. - Leverage AI-augmented approaches to drive efficiency in analytics and reporting workflows — reducing preparation time, improving data integrity, and enabling faster leadership decisions. 3. Cross-Functional Program Leadership - Lead a defined portfolio of cross-functional programs where the Business Management & Strategic Programs team provides connective tissue — defining scope, assembling working teams, tracking milestones, and surfacing blockers. - Interface with Technology & Operations, AI & Data Analytics, Legal, and Finance on behalf of the VP and EVP/GM — aligning resources, resolving dependencies, and ensuring delivery visibility without duplicating existing PMO ownership. - Coach Research leadership team members and their direct teams through operating model shifts, new governance structures, and strategic pivots as directed. - Support the clean transition of successfully validated initiatives into their permanent organizational home, with full documentation and handoff. data.description:
The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team. Location: This is a Globally remote role.   What your day will look like - Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio - Organize and lead the team’s processes in order to help it achieve its objectives - Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members - Identify and measure team health indicators - Interact with a vibrant community - Review code produced by other engineers - Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions - Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals - Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events  What we are looking for in you - A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery - Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source - A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve - Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions - An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university - Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events Additional skills that you might also bring The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them. - Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools. - Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud. - Experience with building machine learning models - Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.) - Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) - Experience in the Linux and open-source software world - Working knowledge of cloud computing - Passionate about software quality and testing - Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions. - Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.   - Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! - Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year - Annual compensation review - Recognition rewards - Annual holiday leave - Maternity and paternity leave - Employee Assistance Programme - Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others - Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #LI-remote

company.name: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey

data.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds. About the Role This is the mid-level analyst position within Actuarial department. Includes all aspects of actuarial work, as related to Stop Loss and Level Funded groups. Responsible for pricing, UW support, reserving and forecasting for both Specific and Aggregate Stop Loss, as well as Level Funding.What You'll Do - Design, perform or support trend analysis - Perform pricing, UW support, reserving and forecasting for both Specific and Aggregate Stop Loss, as well as Level Funding. - Perform or support forecasting - Support new business and renewal pricing decisions, including underwriting consultation and risk assessment. - Develop or support the development of pricing models and support pricing requests which may include, benefit adjustment factors, fee schedule analysis, new product pricing, etc. - Collect and analyze data to use for financial and utilization analysis, reporting, and monitoring (including IBNR) - Partner with internal and external customers to develop creative solutions and strategies, uncover opportunities and minimize risks - Support corporate strategies and business plan development for membership growth & financial strength - Lead meetings with business partners providing transparency in and an understanding of the actuarial analyses and results What You Bring Education/Experience: - Requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably within Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Sciences or a related field from an accredited college or university. - Requires 2+ years of Actuarial and/or statistics experience. - Working towards an ASA highly preferred. - Experience with Level Funded products, medical Stop Loss or Reinsurance products preferred. Knowledge: - Excellent knowledge of features of Stop Loss product, from both Actuarial and UW perspective. - Knowledge of the Reinsurance industry - Requires expert knowledge of Excel. - Experience with SQL, SAS, Tableau, Power BI, or other analytical/reporting tools preferred. - Requires strong working knowledge of data analysis and Actuarial principles. - Requires in depth knowledge of the healthcare industry. Skills & Abilities: - Requires excellent oral and written communication skills. - Requires strong analytical thinking. - Requires strong mathematical skill and statistical analysis abilities. - Requires good judgment and problem-solving skills. Why Horizon? At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you! Salary Range: $79,100 - $105,945​This compensation range is specific to the job level and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Horizon also provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes: - Comprehensive health benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision) - Retirement Plans - Generous PTO - Incentive Plans - Wellness Programs - Paid Volunteer Time Off - Tuition Reimbursement Disclaimer: Horizon BCBSNJ employees must live in New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut or Delaware. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of colleagues assigned to this job. data.title: Microsoft AI Engineer
data.description:
Position: Microsoft AI EngineerJob Description: Arrow Enterprise Computing Solutions (ECS), a part of Arrow Electronics, brings innovative IT solutions to market to solve complex business challenges. We deliver value-added distribution, business consulting and channel enablement services to leading technology manufacturers and their channel partners. We help businesses grow faster, operate more efficiently and transform in a dynamic market. We are looking for a Microsoft AI Engineer to join our growing Microsoft team and support the development of AI agent solutions across EMEA. The Role As a Microsoft AI Engineer, you will support partners, internal teams and end customers across EMEA with the design, development, integration and implementation of AI agents. You will help translate customer needs into practical solutions, contribute to proof of concepts and quick developments, and guide stakeholders on how Microsoft technologies can be used to deliver effective AI agent outcomes. Your Responsibilities - Support partners, internal teams and end customers across EMEA with the development and integration of AI agents. - Contribute to proof of concepts, demos and quick/simple developments that show how AI agents can address customer challenges. - Engage in customer and partner discussions to understand business needs and help define the best implementation approach for AI agents. - Provide guidance on Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio and related AI capabilities. - Help partners identify relevant AI agent use cases and translate them into practical, commercially relevant solutions. - Collaborate with internal sales, technical and vendor teams to support AI-related opportunities and customer engagements. - Share knowledge, best practices and learnings around emerging AI agent topics with internal teams and partners. - Support customer-facing conversations by explaining technical concepts in a clear and accessible way. - Maintain awareness of developments in Microsoft AI technologies, security considerations and the broader AI agent landscape. Your Profile - Good understanding of Microsoft technologies, with strong Microsoft knowledge preferred. - Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio or similar AI agent technologies would be a strong advantage. - Some development skills, including the ability to create quick prototypes or use “vibe coding” approaches to support proof-of-concept work. - Understanding of AI agent development and integration; this is not a pure developer role, but the successful candidate should be comfortable discussing and shaping AI agent solutions. - Ability to support partners and customers in defining practical implementation approaches for AI agents. - Customer-facing experience is preferred, although candidates with the right attitude, strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement ability will also be considered. - Strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently with internal teams, partners and customers across different countries and functions. - Microsoft certifications would be a plus. - Fluent English is essential; an additional European language would be a plus but is not mandatory. - Willingness to travel occasionally across EMEA What We Offer - Structured development opportunities and vendor certifications across our AI portfolio - The backing of a global organization with established relationships across the world's leading AI vendors Arrow is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment by providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Location: NL-Netherlands - RemoteTime Type: Full timeJob Category: Sales
